description: Database of UI patterns to actively avoid - The tired trends of modern web design

patterns.name: particle_canvas
patterns.why_avoid: Every SaaS landing page has this. It's visual noise that adds nothing.

patterns.name: glitch_text
patterns.description: CSS/JS text glitch effects with color channels splitting
patterns.why_avoid: Overused in 'edgy' portfolios. Usually hurts readability.

patterns.name: scanlines
patterns.why_avoid: Fake nostalgia that adds loading time and nothing else.

patterns.name: custom_cursor
patterns.why_avoid: Accessibility nightmare. Users expect system cursors.

patterns.name: gradient_mesh
patterns.why_avoid: Every startup copied Apple. Time to move on.

patterns.name: blob_morphing
patterns.why_avoid: Became a cliché after every UI kit included them.

patterns.name: noise_texture
patterns.why_avoid: Usually just adds file size. Rarely adds value.

colors.description: Color schemes that have been done to death

patterns.name: neon_pink_blue
patterns.description: Hot pink (#FF00FF) to electric blue (#00FFFF) gradients
patterns.why_avoid: Every 'futuristic' design since 2018. It's exhausting.

patterns.name: gradient_trendy
patterns.why_avoid: Indistinguishable from a million other sites.

patterns.name: dark_mode_default
patterns.description: Dark backgrounds with neon accents by default
patterns.why_avoid: Dark mode is fine, but it's become the lazy default.

patterns.name: pastel_everything
patterns.why_avoid: Overused in productivity/wellness apps. Feels generic.

layouts.description: Structural patterns that have become visual white noise

patterns.name: hero_generic
patterns.description: Standard hero with big text left, image/mockup right
patterns.why_avoid: Users scroll past without reading. It's invisible.

patterns.name: card_grid
patterns.description: Uniform grid of cards with icons and short descriptions
patterns.why_avoid: Information gets lost in visual sameness.

patterns.name: bento_boxes
patterns.why_avoid: Trendy in 2023, already tired. Use with caution.

patterns.name: fullscreen_sections
patterns.why_avoid: Breaks natural reading flow. Frustrates users.

patterns.name: sticky_everything
patterns.description: Multiple sticky elements competing for attention
examples: Sticky nav + sticky sidebar + sticky CTA
patterns.why_avoid: Reduces actual content space. Mobile nightmare.

interactions.description: Animation and interaction patterns that are overdone

patterns.name: parallax
patterns.why_avoid: Often causes motion sickness. Usually pointless.

patterns.name: scroll_reveal
patterns.description: Elements animate in as you scroll (fade up, slide in)
patterns.why_avoid: Slows down content consumption. Gets annoying.

patterns.name: hover_effects_classic
patterns.why_avoid: So common they're invisible. No differentiation.

patterns.name: scroll_hijacking
patterns.why_avoid: Breaks user expectations. Accessibility issues.

patterns.name: loading_animations
patterns.why_avoid: Usually hides poor performance. Just make it faster.

typography.description: Text treatments that have become clichés

patterns.name: distortion_acid
patterns.why_avoid: Sacrifices readability for 'art'. Usually fails at both.

patterns.name: brutalism_helvetica
patterns.why_avoid: The 'ironic' ugly became genuinely ugly.

patterns.name: variable_font_tricks
patterns.description: Animating variable font axes for effect
patterns.why_avoid: Often distracting. Rarely adds meaning.

patterns.name: giant_headlines
patterns.description: Extremely large display text (200px+) as design element
patterns.why_avoid: Everyone does this now. Lost its impact.

patterns.name: gradient_text
patterns.description: Gradient fills on text via background-clip
patterns.why_avoid: Cool in 2020, dated in 2024.

components.description: UI components that have been cloned into oblivion

patterns.name: glassmorphism_cards
patterns.description: Frosted glass effect cards with blur
patterns.why_avoid: Every component library has this. No longer distinctive.

patterns.name: neumorphism_buttons
patterns.why_avoid: Poor contrast. Accessibility nightmare. The trend is dead.

patterns.name: floating_labels
patterns.description: Input labels that animate from placeholder to top
patterns.why_avoid: Actually causes usability issues. Use static labels.

patterns.name: rounded_everything
patterns.why_avoid: Became the default. Sharp edges are refreshing now.

patterns.name: icon_overload
patterns.description: Icons for everything, even when text is clearer
patterns.why_avoid: Icons are ambiguous. Words are clear.

combination_warnings.warning: This combo was peak 2022. Consider a different direction.
